description: Add a block to a page (auto-generates the block id). Pass layoutRegion to add a layout block; omit it for a content block in the page body. Only call after the user confirms. If the result includes blockWarnings, the saved content violates the workspace block manifest (unknown field, wrong value shape, or a stored block whose type is no longer registered) - correct the content and save again, unless the warning is about a stored block whose type is no longer registered: that one is a manifest problem, so restore or sync the type, or find the block with list_block_usage and migrate or remove it. A block whose type the workspace block manifest does not register is refused unless the page already stores that block - pick registered types from list_block_types.

content.description: Language-keyed content: { en: { title: '...' } }. A relation field stores record id(s) from list_records - a single id string (hasOne) or an array of id strings (hasMany).

layoutRegion.description: Layout region (e.g. 'header','footer') for a layout block; omit for a content block

position.description: 0-based insert position (content blocks only; default: end)

name: add_block_to_page
